title: Human Checkpoint Decision Record (v1)
description: Append-only evidence artifact for one human checkpoint decision. The recorded role is a declaration, never a verified identity; the run_manifest.human_checkpoints row remains the control truth that gates read.

previous_decision_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the previous decision artifact file bytes in append order; absent for the first decision. Raises detectability of silent decision rewrites, not tamper resistance.
